data.name: AboutDescription

data.name: Problem_CertificateUntrusted

data.name: Problem_ConfigRejected

data.name: Problem_ConnectionRefused

data.name: Problem_ConnectionReset
data.value: The connection to the server was reset. Your ISP may be blocking this protocol — try another profile.

data.name: Problem_ConnectionTimeout

data.name: Problem_NetworkUnreachable

data.name: Problem_PortInUse

data.name: Problem_RealityRejected

data.name: Problem_RealityRejected_SingBox

data.name: Problem_ServerNotFound

data.name: Problem_TlsHandshakeFailed

data.name: SettingsAutoReconnectHint
data.value: If the connection drops by itself (the core exited, the service restarted), KHORS connects again: after 1, 2, 4… up to 60 s, or as soon as the network is back. After a network change or sleep the connection is checked and restarted if needed. Kill Switch stays on meanwhile. With Auto, another server is picked instead.

data.name: SettingsCoresHint
data.value: Xray and sing-box from the official GitHub releases. Checking and downloading happen only on request; updates stay within the series of this KHORS version (Xray 26.x, sing-box 1.14.x) and are verified by checksum and KHORS configs. The window and the service update their own copies; a new core is used from the next connection.

data.name: SettingsDnsHint
data.value: Where KHORS sends site name lookups in TUN mode and for WireGuard. Lookups go through the server, so your provider does not see them; an address on the local network (such as your router) is queried directly. In System proxy mode the server resolves names. Changes apply from the next connection.

data.name: SettingsGeoHint
data.value: Lists of domains and IP addresses by country and category for routing rules (for example, “Bypass for Russia”). They are downloaded from GitHub (v2fly) and verified by checksum; the KHORS service keeps its own copy for TUN mode.

data.name: SettingsKillSwitchHint
data.value: Leak protection in TUN mode: if the tunnel drops, the computer's traffic is blocked instead of going direct. Works through the KHORS service.

data.name: SettingsModeHint
data.value: The mode can be changed while connected too — KHORS reconnects in the new mode. TUN requires the KHORS service.

data.name: SettingsResetHint
data.value: If the internet does not work after KHORS: removes everything KHORS changed in the system — the system proxy, TUN mode and its adapter, Kill Switch filters. Other programs and your own network settings are not touched.

data.name: SettingsRoutingHint
data.value: What goes through the server and what goes direct. Works in both modes; changes apply from the next connection.

data.name: SettingsServiceHint
data.value: Needed only for TUN mode: it creates the network adapter and routes. Installed once; Windows will ask for administrator rights.
